Your Guide

Meet Emil — Your
Island Storyteller

Born and raised in Sri Lanka, Emil Jayasekara has spent over 14 years travelling every corner of his island — from the ancient kingdoms of the north to the whale waters of the deep south. He isn't a guide who reads from a script; he's a storyteller who grew up among these temples, jungles, and tea estates.

Guests consistently describe the same experience: Emil feels less like a hired driver and more like a trusted friend who happens to know every hidden waterfall, every family-run curry house, and every leopard trail in the country. He photographs your moments, remembers your birthday, and stays reachable every evening in case you need anything.

SLTDA-certified and fully insured, Emil drives with care, guides with honesty, and plans every detail so you can be completely present — no logistics, no stress, just Sri Lanka at its most authentic.

One Guide. Your Journey.

Emil is personally present for every single tour — not assigned to you from a pool. You're travelling with the man who designed your route.

Deeply Local Knowledge

14 years guiding has taken Emil down every back road, into every village, and across every national park. His insight transforms sights into stories.

5-Star Rated

312 five-star reviews on TripAdvisor and Google from travellers across 40+ countries. Words like "life-changing" appear more than you'd expect.

Fully Customisable

Every itinerary bends to your preferences — pace, accommodation style, dietary needs, special occasions. No rigid fixed-group tours here.

Fully Insured & Licensed

SLTDA certified, fully insured vehicle and guide. Your safety and peace of mind are non-negotiable foundations of every tour.

Eco-Responsible Travel

Sustainable itineraries, community-supporting stops, and genuine wildlife ethics. Emil's philosophy is to give back to the island more than we take.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking. Can't find your answer? Ask Emil directly.

All tours include Emil as your personal chauffeur guide, a private air-conditioned vehicle, accommodation as specified, daily breakfast, all entrance fees (monuments, parks, safaris), airport transfers, and all applicable taxes. There are no hidden fees.

Absolutely — every itinerary is a starting point, not a fixed script. Tell Emil your interests, preferred pace, accommodation budget, and must-see experiences, and he'll redesign the route around you. Customisation is free and unlimited.

Contact Emil directly via WhatsApp, the inquiry form, or email. He'll confirm availability, answer your questions, and send a formal quote within 24 hours. A 30% deposit secures your dates, with the balance due 14 days before your tour starts.

Sri Lanka has two monsoon seasons affecting different coasts. The south and west (Colombo, Galle, Mirissa) are best from December to March. The east coast (Trincomalee, Arugam Bay) is perfect June to September. The Cultural Triangle and Hill Country are accessible year-round with occasional showers. Emil will advise the best dates for your specific route.

Sri Lanka is a very safe and welcoming country for tourists. Emil monitors all security and travel advisories and maintains full insurance coverage. He's been guiding international visitors for 14 years without incident and your safety is his highest priority.

Emil operates exclusively private tours — no shared groups ever. The standard vehicle comfortably seats 2–4 guests. For families or groups of 5+, Emil arranges a larger vehicle or coordinates a second guide. Tours remain 100% private regardless of group size.

Emil works with a curated network of boutique hotels, luxury eco-lodges, colonial bungalows, and jungle camps — all personally vetted. Your accommodation can be adjusted to any budget from comfortable guesthouse to full luxury. He'll show you options at every tier before you confirm.

Cancellations made 30+ days before departure receive a full refund of the deposit. 15–29 days: 50% refund. Under 14 days: no refund. Emil strongly recommends travel insurance, which can cover unforeseen cancellations on your end. All cancellations are handled with full transparency and fairness.
